description: Send a text message from a connected number. Free-form text only reaches people who messaged that number in the last 24 hours; otherwise use bridge_send_template. This sends a real message.

biz_opaque_callback_data.description: Optional biz_opaque_callback_data: your own reference (order id, ticket id), max 512 chars. Meta returns it on every status webhook of this message as data.biz_opaque_callback_data.

idempotency_key.description: Optional Idempotency-Key (1-255 chars). Reuse the same key when retrying the same message: a repeat with the same key and body within 24 hours returns the original response and does not send again.

to.description: Recipient phone in international format without + (e.g. 60123456789) or a BSUID.

waba_id.description: WhatsApp Business Account ID registered to your partner account (see bridge_list_numbers).

name: bridge_send_text
title: Send a WhatsApp text message
